title: The Thursday 'This week' email prints an exact venue the host chose to hide

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: lib/this-week-reads.ts:31 selects location and venue_name but never hide_address, and lib/this-week.ts:125 (eventWhere) mails venue_name or location to every member in the region. A public regional event with hide_address=true has its address mailed out, the leak SCAN-209 closed on the page. THE FIX: select hide_address, street, region and build the line with publicVisibleLocation(row).
